integrity: The proof is a symbolic exponent reduction of the published theorem followed by an exact optimization over its fixed integer parameter. Exact-rational replay checks the reduction, diagonal recovery, and a non-diagonal example.
scientific_limitations: The criterion classifies exactly when the upper bound in Theorem 1.1 yields a power saving under fixed positive power-law exponents and strict source-size assumptions. It does not claim necessity for actual character-sum cancellation; boundary equality is not included because of the \(p^{o(1)}\) factor.
title: An exact anisotropic power-saving region for constant-weight polynomial character sums
